title: Elf Bar ElfX Ultra Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elf Bar ELFX Ultra Pod Vape Kit brings intelligent design and high-end functionality to the world of refillable pod kits. With a 2.4" full touch screen, smart vaping modes and companion app connectivity, this device offers a highly customisable experience in a compact, stylish form. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) and direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping styles, the ELFX Ultra supports dual mesh pods and two power modes: Eco Mode for extended coil lifespan and Turbo Mode for fuller flavour and vapour. Power is fully adjustable between 5W and 45W and can be controlled directly on the touch screen or via the Smart Insights app, which also provides usage tracking, custom settings and age-lock options for added safety. The ELFX Ultra uses the same pod platform as the wider ELFX Series, with a clean top-fill mechanism and anti-leak design. Mesh coil resistances include 0.6ohm and 0.8ohm, with additional pod options due to follow. The device features an adjustable airflow slider and allows you to fine-tune performance through screen brightness, locking modes, RGB light settings, and even visual themes. A built-in 1500mAh battery supports USB-C fast charging and provides reliable all-day power. With a sleek zinc alloy frame, fully interactive display, and the ability to pair with the ELF Smart App for advanced control, the ELFX Ultra represents a major step forward in refillable pod technology. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
